incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-proxy-us-east" (pd-INC-4821) — threshold error_rate > 5% breached. Trigger: 5xx spike. Auto-escalation: page oncall.
Jordan: acked — I'm oncall. Looking at the dashboards now.
Jordan: pinging other regions, any customer tickets?
Kai: seeing a ~12% 5xx spike on the proxy in us-east, starts 04:12 UTC. Metric source looks like synthetic canary traffic hitting /generate. No corresponding increase in support mentions.
Priya: logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` to backend pool inference-private-01, lots of short lived connections. Might be a ramp from a test harness.
Jordan: running quick healthcheck: 
```bash
# healthcheck
curl -sS https://proxy-us-east.internal/health | jq .
```
Jordan: output: {"status":"degraded", "backends_active": 42, "5xx_rate": 0.12}
Kai: correlating request ids — big batch from internal job id `ci-load-7472`. Looks like a CI load test started unexpectedly.
Priya: I'm going to try throttling CI traffic. Paging @Matt from CI infra to pause the job.
Matt: on it — pausing ci-load-7472 now. ETA ~30s for traffic to drop.
Jordan: noted. Customer-facing SLOs: p95 latency jumped 120ms -> 200ms for <0.5% of requests in us-east. No active customer incidents. Severity: low/no-customer-impact.
Kai: will keep an eye on backend error traces after the pause.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert pd-INC-4821 auto-resolved — condition returned below threshold.
Jordan: thanks — closing from oncall. Follow-up: add CI filter to the alert rule so synthetic runs don't fire this pager. Priya can you open a follow-up ticket?
Priya: creating INF-2147: "Exclude CI canaries from inference-proxy 5xx alert; add CI tags to alerting rules". Adding runbook note: how to throttle/PAUSE CI job (step-by-step).
Kai: also recommending CI jobs include metadata tag `ci_source:true` so we can blacklist them in alerting. I'll file a quick infra PR.
Jordan: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Matt: confirmed job paused and traffic returned to baseline.
Jordan: marking thread resolved. If any customer reports surface, will reopen. :eyes:
